note: Aus rice (WB/Assam/Odisha) is sown Apr-May and harvested Aug-Sep
Aman rice is transplanted Jun-Aug and harvested Nov-Dec: the main kharif crop
Boro rice and summer pulses; sown Dec-Feb or Mar and harvested by June
Crops whose app season is perennial are relabelled perennial
Dropped: the sum of the other seasons
